title: Lemma 2.12: existence of an essentially small sifted-fiber Cartesian fibration of elementary objects
statement_scope: Let T be a pregeometry and X an infinity-topos, and let O be an object of Str^loc_T(X) whose underlying object of X is final. Then there exists a full subcategory E of the slice Str^loc_T(X)_{/O}, containing the terminal object, such that the composite q: E -> Str^loc_T(X) -> X is a Cartesian fibration whose fibers are essentially small and admit finite coproducts, and every object of E is elementary.
